Name: Futanari Anime Slime mother
Author: wcaxeman
Description:
Just put it in the mod folder. Although it’s my first pixel animation, I think it works well, the form is accurate and dynamic and realistic, and it shows the obsessive feeling of Futanari masturbating and orgasming. Of course, the characters come from the paintings of Uno Makoto, thanks to the great artist of Futanari. In addition, I created an original futanari plain Slime’s PNG pixelated image of Slime holding her penis and masturbating her vagina with her fingers while she continues to orgasm, without any reference to the work of any writer, but because the game’s use of pixel maps isn’t what I initially thought it would be, it won’t be able to show the full range of Futanari’s ordinary Slime actions. The Koshi lime map in the content folder, a five line image of lime’s body, theoretically corresponds to facing forward, facing right and left, facing away from the screen, and charging through the air. But in the actual game, the middle three lines are not shown at all, so in the actual game there are only positive animations and sprints, whereas in the original game Slime’s body orientation is actually reflected by the position of his eyes, because the outline of the body is a simple sphere in any direction, it is uniform.

[u][b] If the total tip is more than $15, I will upload this Futanari plain Slime texture file containing four directional poses that you can simply edit in Photoshop and apply to other character maps. I’m sure the animation is great


[/b][/u]只要放到mod文件夹里就行了。虽然是我的第一个像素动画作品，但我认为它运作的很好，形体准确动态真实，可以表现出futanari自慰并高潮的那种沉迷的感觉。当然，人物形象来源于uno makoto 的画，在此感谢这位futanari绘画大师。此外，我还绘制了并没有参考任何作家作品的原创futanari普通史莱姆的png格式像素画，表现了一个同时握住阴茎并用手指自慰阴道并不断高潮的扶她史莱姆，但是由于游戏对于像素贴图的利用并非我一开始想的那样，游戏无法呈现futanari普通史莱姆的全部方向的动作。在content文件夹中的小史莱姆贴图，绘制有小史莱姆身躯的图片有五行，理论上分别对应朝前、朝右和左侧、背对屏幕，以及冲次攻击。但是实际在游戏中，中间三行根本不会展现出来，所以实际游戏中只会有正面动画和冲刺动画，而原版游戏里实际上通过眼睛的位置体现史莱姆身子的朝向，因为身体的轮廓在任何一个方位上都是一个简单的球形，是一致的。如果累计打赏超过15美元，我将上传这个包含了四个方向姿势的futanari普通史莱姆贴图文件，你可以将它用ps简单编辑并应用在其他人物贴图上。我保证其动画效果很棒。
